text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I spent my day off coming up with a
brand-new
coffee blend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think this blend is one of my finest
works...
Would you like to try some with
me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe returns from her
productive day
off completely refreshed.
